title.narrative: Youth Leader Exchange for the Musalaha Youth Group in Betlehem

description.narrative: The Youth Leader exchange program is an essential part of IU and Musalaha’s Partnership Project taking place from 2022 to 2024. The partnership consists of 30 Palestinian and Danish young adults between 20-35 years old that will be supported by a Palestinian Core Committee and a Danish Steering Committee. This Youth Leader Exchange project is designed to support the Palestinian Core Committee, implement the monthly youth group meetings, execute a total of 9 outreaches, and assist in the maintenance and running of the Youth Center in Bethlehem, which is an essential part of the partnership project. Additionally, the Youth Leaders assume responsibility for one major event; a weekend workshop on Freedom of Religion or Belief for the entire youth group (Budget line 800). The Youth Leaders will also be an essential resource in advocacy work in both Palestine and Denmark and create weekly video updates, promoting the project and simultaneously advocating for reconciliation.
